items.markdown:
![Easy Chicken Pad Thai Recipe - Belly Full](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280155-1672-0139-0000-79f921c6e48f:6)
Pad Thai contains `thin flat rice noodles, a sweet-salty-sour sauce, and scrambled eggs` . It is traditionally stir-fried with aromatics, vegetables, and proteins like shrimp or tofu.[](https://www.recipetineats.com/chicken-pad-thai/) [[1]](https://www.recipetineats.com/chicken-pad-thai/)[[2]](https://thai-foodie.com/thaifood/pad-thai-the-complete-authentic-guide/)[[3]](https://inquiringchef.com/easy-pad-thai/)[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pad_thai)

Core Ingredients

- **Noodles:** Thin, flat rice noodles soaked and stir-fried.
- **Sauce:** A balance of tamarind paste, fish sauce, and palm sugar.
- **Protein:** Firm pressed tofu, shrimp (prawns), or chicken.
- **Vegetables & Aromatics:** Fresh bean sprouts, garlic chives (or green onions), chopped shallots, and garlic.
- **Extras:** Scrambled eggs and sweet preserved radish.[](https://www.recipetineats.com/chicken-pad-thai/) [[1]](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/pad-thai)[[2]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/best-pad-thai/)

Garnishes

- Crushed roasted peanuts
- Fresh lime wedges
- Chili flakes
- Extra raw bean sprouts[](https://www.recipetineats.com/chicken-pad-thai/) 

For tips on how to caramelize the sugar and balance the sweet, salty, and sour flavors:![Related video thumbnail](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcS6xcbWhTOns73NJjwEtyy6pRGM2GF11NQc757E5TD65WTxjc1D)
